{{Quote|Derg? You mean the biologist. That's interesting. I was just thinking about him after reading the HoloNet. What is Derg up to these days?''"<br />"''Well sir, he is dead.|[[Cale Herron]] and a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BJE" />}}
'''Derg Prantis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] biologist who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|This is Derg Prantis and it may very well may be my last recording. I've barricaded myself in the biolab hoping to buy some time while I contact the authorities but someone is jamming my comm-signal. If you get this data disk, Bera, please take it to Cale Herron at Mos Taike. Oh no...please! I am unarmed...|Derg Prantis|<ref name="SWG:BJE" />}}
Derg Prantis was a biologist serving as chief scientist of the [[Mos Eisley Biolab]], based in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. One of his employees was the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] lab assistant [[Bera Jeza]].<ref name="SWG:BJE" />

[[File:SecretLaboratory2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Derg Prantis' secret lab.]]
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Derg Prantis obtained a sample of the dreadful [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scientist.<ref name="SWG:TP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Plan|Tatooine}}</ref> The Empire had secretly recruited a group of scientists on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to turn the virus into a [[bioweapon]].<ref name="SWG:ID">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Investigate Dathomir|Lok}}</ref> Prantis therefore built a [[Secret Laboratory|secret laboratory]] on the remote planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] to conduct his own research on the virus in order to create a super soldier drug. The scientist recruited his lab assistant Bera Jeza to help him the project. However, Jeza soon betrayed her employer and contacted the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] to sell him the super soldier drug. Having discovered the betrayal, Derg Prantis requested his long time associate [[Cale Herron]] to help him evacuate his secret lab and destroy evidence.<ref name="SWG:TP" /> However, the lab was brutally attacked before Herron could intervene and the entire staff was assassinated.<ref name="SWG:FC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find Clues|Lok}}</ref> Prantis eventually returned to the Mos Eisley Biolab on Tatooine.<ref name="SWG:BJE" />

[[File:DergPrantis.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Derg Prantis, alive during his final recording.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the laboratory in Mos Eisley was attacked and Prantis was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]]. In the meanwhile, Bera Jeza was murdered in a street of Mos Eisley. As Jeza had ties with Jabba the Hutt, his majordomo [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]] hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to investigate the crime. The spacer discovered Prantis's corpse in the laboratory along with a [[Datacard/Legends|data disk]]. The disk contained Derg Prantis's last words, with instructions to contact Cale Herron in [[Mos Taike/Legends|Mos Taike]].<ref name="SWG:BJE" /> With the help of Herron, the spacer investigated Derg Prantis's secret lab on Lok.<ref name="SWG:FC" /> The investigation finally led to the discovery of a [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|Blackwing outbreak]] on Dathomir.<ref name="SWG:ID" />

==Behind the scenes==
Derg Prantis appeared as a dead [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BJE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Derg Prantis was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 13|Game Update 13]]," released on [[September 30]], [[2009]].<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1003113|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 13 -- Chronicle Master System}}</ref> This NPC was part of the questline "[[W:c:swg:Something is Obviously Wrong|Something is Obviously Wrong]],"<ref name="SWG:BJE" /> an introduction to the "[[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|Death Troopers]]" [[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|update]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
